text:
Maya Chen: Hey team — just got my desk kit. Monitor and USB-C dock arrived but no DisplayPort cable in the box, and the dock only flickers power. Also my mac isn't joining corp-wifi, it says certificate not trusted. who should I ping for replacements and wifi onboarding?
IT Helpdesk: Welcome Maya! Sorry about that. Can you DM the order number from your onboarding email? we'll check the packing list and open a shipping ticket.
Maya Chen: order #ONB-94270 (shipped to SF office). i can DM it.
Sam (IT Shipping): I see the order — DP cable was shipped separately as "accessory pack" on a different label. Looks like it got delayed. I can overnight a DP-to-DP cable (1.8m) and a power replacement for the dock. ETA tomorrow noon. Shipping ticket: SHIP-1138.
Maya Chen: amazing, thank you! do you need the serial for the dock?
IT Helpdesk: If the dock is under warranty, serial helps. If it keeps blinking, we can RMA. Can you run this quick check: unplug power, hold the power button on the dock for 10s, then plug back in and let me know LEDs.
Maya Chen: did that — LED blinks amber 3x then off, then blue slowly.
Alex Rivera: that pattern usually means firmware didn't finish booting. If you can plug the dock directly into laptop with just the power (no monitor) and run `system_profiler SPUSBDataType` (mac) or `lsusb -v` (linux) share output (just the vendor/product id ok) we can confirm.
Maya Chen: running mac command now, output snippet: `Vendor ID: 0x17ef  Product ID: 0x3067`
Alex Rivera: thanks. that's a known vendor id for the dock series. we'll mark it as flaky — Sam, include an RMA unit in SHIP-1138 if the replacement doesn't get it stable.
it-bot: Ticket created: IT-24567 (wifi enrollment), assigned to Alex Rivera.
Maya Chen: about corp-wifi — when i try to join it prompts for cert and fails with "certificate not trusted". I clicked the 'Enroll device' link in the welcome email but it errors with 403.
Alex Rivera: 403 on enroll usually means SSO enrollment flag not set on your account yet. I just requested approval from access-controls. Should be active in ~30min. Meanwhile try this manual install: download the profile at `https://intranet.redwood.com/profiles/corpwifi.mobileconfig` then open it and follow prompts. On mac: `open corpwifi.mobileconfig` then in Profiles preferences click install.
Maya Chen: ok trying manual install... install succeeded, wifi connects but it complains about captive portal cert until i restart — rebooting now.
Maya Chen: reboot done — wifi stable, thanks! :tada:
IT Helpdesk: great. we'll keep SHIP-1138 open until you confirm the dock/power & DP cable arrival. Flagging SHIP-1138 to high priority.
Maya Chen: appreciate it. tagging here in case others hit same: if your packing slip shows missing accessory pack, file to shipping and include the order number.
Sam (IT Shipping): noted. I updated SHIP-1138 with tracking (UPS 1Z999AA10123456784). Expected delivery tomorrow 11:45am.
Maya Chen: got tracking, i'll confirm when it arrives. thanks all! :raised_hands:
